title: 小学五年级
description: 适合10-11岁孩子，章节书阅读、新闻类短片、跨学科英语、批判性思维启蒙
descriptionEn: For children aged 10-11. Chapter book reading, news-style shorts, cross-subject English, critical thinking starters.

items.description: BBC儿童新闻节目，用孩子能懂的语言讲时事，新闻英语+全球视野。
items.descriptionEn: BBC children's news program. Current events explained in kid-friendly language. News English plus global perspective.

items.description: 用搞笑短剧讲真实历史，莎士比亚到二战全覆盖，英式幽默+历史词汇量爆炸。
items.descriptionEn: Funny sketches about real history, from Shakespeare to WWII. British humor plus explosive history vocabulary.

items.description: Ricky用日常材料做创意手工，艺术词汇+步骤指令英语，动手又动脑。
items.descriptionEn: Ricky makes creative crafts from everyday materials. Art vocabulary plus step-by-step instruction English. Hands-on and brain-on.

items.description: Nekton一家探索深海秘密，科幻冒险+海洋生物词汇，画面精美像动画电影。
items.descriptionEn: The Nekton family explores deep sea mysteries. Sci-fi adventure plus marine vocabulary. Cinematic animation quality.

items.description: 特工小孩用数学解决奇怪事件，数学逻辑+推理对话，幽默又烧脑。
items.descriptionEn: Kid agents solve weird cases using math. Math logic plus deduction dialogue. Funny and mind-bending.

items.description: BBC自然纪录片经典，少儿版解说语速适中，自然科普英语天花板。
items.descriptionEn: BBC nature documentary classic. Kids' version has moderate narration speed. The ceiling of nature science English.

items.description: BBC最长寿的儿童节目，手工制作、挑战任务、动物嘉宾应有尽有，地道英式英语。
items.descriptionEn: BBC's longest-running children's show. Crafts, challenge tasks, animal guests. Authentic British English.

items.description: BBC儿童新闻节目，用孩子能懂的语言讲时事，新闻英语+全球视野。
items.descriptionEn: BBC children's news program. Current events explained in kid-friendly language. News English plus global perspective.

items.description: 双胞胎医生兄弟用实验和医院实拍讲解人体知识，医学词汇丰富但讲解有趣不吓人。
items.descriptionEn: Twin doctor brothers explain human body knowledge through experiments and hospital footage. Rich medical vocabulary, fun and not scary.
